facts_zh:
Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
- Published
The death of US actress Hayden Panettiere has been ruled accidental, ending a local probe into her death, police in South Carolina have said.
The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs in her system, at the age of 36.
Citing the medical examiner's report last month that found Panettiere died from a drug overdose, the Greenville Police Department said it had "concluded its investigation" into her death.

- Published
Partial results from Israel's general election show veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is leading his rival, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, but is still short of a majority in parliament.
With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox Jewish allies were on track to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.
Eisenkot's Yashar party and three other Jewish opposition parties in his bloc were set for 48.

Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
- Published
A luxury cruise ship on a years-long voyage around the world said it suspended operations due to extraordinarily high fuel costs, leaving passengers stranded in Cambodia.
The US-based operator of the Villa Vie Odyssey said it was working with passengers on disembarkation plans and "temporary living arrangements".
It is unclear how many were on board but the nearly 200m (656ft) vessel can carry up to 650 passengers.

articles.title_zh: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
facts_zh:
Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
- Published
Tanzania has announced a significant discovery of natural gas in the Mnazi Bay area in the south of the country - the first such find in a decade.

Energy Minister Juma Homera attended a ceremony at the Kasa-1X ST2 well, which is jointly owned by state-owned Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation (TPDC) and French oil firm Maurel & Prom, to mark the occasion.
He said the estimated 223 billion cubic feet (6.3 billion cubic metres) discovery was a "major milestone" in the development of the small oil and gas sector in the East African nation.

all_titles.en: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years

articles.title_original: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
articles.title_zh: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
facts_zh: Jean Kaseya, of the Africa CDC, warns of the illness spreading like Covid unless more funding is secured to increase preparedness and possible treatment The “unprecedented” spread of the Ebola outbreak means it could reach the UK and other countries, according to one of Africa’s top health officials.

As the current outbreak reached 10,000 cases, with almost 5,000 deaths , Dr Jean Kaseya, director general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), compared the outbreak to the Covid pandemic, which first took hold in China before spreading to countries across the world, claiming millions of lives, and ravaging health systems and economies.

articles.title_original: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
articles.title_zh: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
facts_zh:
Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
- Published
The family of a Kenyan woman allegedly murdered by a former British soldier 14 years ago has expressed outrage after being told an extradition hearing for the accused had been postponed until May 2027.

Relatives of Agnes Wanjiru, whose body was found in a septic tank near a British army training camp in Kenya in 2012, described the delay as "completely unacceptable" and have accused the authorities of failing to keep them informed.
Robert James Purkiss was arrested in the UK last November and is fighting extradition to Kenya to face trial for the murder of the 21-year-old mother.

all_titles.en: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
